statement: This receipt records verified production callers and explicitly names retained public seams. It is not a terminal certification for the whole Plan 3.x/4.0 programme.

deepModules.callerBehavior: The evidence CLI derives process facts and digests through observed-source-loader; it does not accept an outcome flag.
Parallel replay telemetry delegates coverage classification and sealing to the deep module.

retainedPublicSeams.reason: Public lifecycle adapter; its observedOutcome receipts are evaluated by the shared core evaluator.
Public lifecycle adapter; an observed outcome overrides a caller-supplied status claim.
taskflow pre-close publishes the inspector output as observedTaskEvidence. It derives an observation digest from persisted command facts and marks malformed facts invalid.

nonClaims: No zero-caller module was deleted merely to satisfy a metric.
No terminal close or runner publication is claimed by this receipt.
Legacy receipts without observedOutcome remain compatible during migration; they are not upgraded by this work.
